A cognitive-style score with possible skew.

```{r}
library(referent)
set.seed(3)
ref <- norm_simulate(350, kind = "shash")
spec <- norm_spec(
  family = norm_shash(),
  location = ~ s(age, k = 6) + sex,
  scale = ~ s(age, k = 4),
  skew = ~ 1,
  tail = ~ 1
)
fit <- norm_fit(spec, data = ref, outcomes = "y")
scores <- predict(fit, newdata = ref[1:5, ], uncertainty = "conditional")
scores[, c(".row", "observed", "centile", "z", "tail_prob")]
```
